name: Ceres
title: Western Liberators
description: The commander of the Western Liberators and the living hope of all Westerners who dream of reclaiming the West. Pursues strength and does not tolerate weakness.
introduction:
The stalwart leader of the Western Liberators, Ceres always stands at the forefront as their commander.
The Western lands, still tainted by lingering Void Cores, have long since become inhospitable to human life, yet Ceres has risen as a final hope among the displaced, calling for the reclamation of the West through sheer force.

A fanatical devotee of training and a strict ascetic, she tolerates no weakness in herself or her subordinates, keeping the Western Liberators sharp in both body and mind through harsh training and discipline.
When denouncing those she deems <color=#2A80D8>soft</color>, Ceres has an oddly frequent habit of resorting to dessert-themed metaphors, though no one has ever dared to point this out to her.

Upon receiving the invitation to the Journey, she chose to participate without hesitation, already filled with plans to form an assault unit against the Void Cores in the West as soon as she inherits the power of the Star Savior.
